topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Oh, it's you! I was just telling the mailman, I said, "Do you know this might be a mix-up?" Got this package, wrapped up neat as a button, but it's clearly not for us. The name on it? Not even close. Figured maybe from when the last folks lived here. What do you think we should do? Return it? I was thinking we could leave it at the post office, make sure it finds its way back to who it really belongs to. It's just the right thing, you know? Hope you're having a good day, and thanks for always being the best kind of neighbor.
